thread:
emily.marketing: Quick sync  we need coordinated customer comms for the embeddings degradation. Goals: clear status copy, when to email, support routing, and whether to pause upcoming benchmark posts/webinar.

alex.sre: Short technical snapshot: fallback routing enabled; ~8-12% of embeddings requests using degraded path. No ETA.

maria.ops: Recommend publish status + in-app banner immediately. Hold social and benchmark posts. Targeted email only to affected accounts after we confirm list (30-90m). Stagger EU send by +2h.

emily.marketing: Draft statuscopy (customer-facing):
```
Were seeing degraded results for embeddings for a subset of requests. An automatic fallback is in place to reduce service interruptions. Our engineers are investigating and well update here. Text generation services are unaffected.
```

julia.social: Agree hold. Ill prepare social-safe messaging for partners/press if needed: short and factual.

kevin.support: Support needs canned reply + routing to priority queue for enterprise accounts. Please provide a short FAQ/workaround for us to paste.

emily.marketing: Proposed FAQ/workaround line: "If embeddings power your search/ranking, consider pinning to model X_v1 or enabling synchronous fallback; contact support if you see production impact."

alex.sre: Confirmed: fallback trades fidelity for availability; share affected-account list from logs in 25m.

maria.ops: Action items: publish status + banner now (maria), hold public posts (julia), compile affected list & add support macro (kevin), marketing to draft targeted email template (emily).

emily.marketing: Email subject option: "Notice: temporary impact on embeddings for some requests" Body: short, empathic, actionable, and promise direct follow-up if impacted. No timeline.

press-bot: [notice] upcoming benchmark/webinar content flagged for hold by marketing.

julia.social: Ill keep the scheduled webinar paused and propose a transparency webinar  "Incident review + reliability improvements"  once postmortem is ready.

emily.marketing: Thanks team. Publish status now and paste any updated copy here so I can finalize email and support snippets. Well reconvene after the account list comes through.
